units.source_text: 诊视完毕，名人坐在病床上，又下起将棋来。

en.t: After the examination was over, the Master sat up on the sickbed and began playing shogi again.

units.source_text: 以小野田六段为对手，采用“银不成”的下法。

en.t: With Onoda, sixth dan, as his opponent, he used the strategy of leaving the silver general unpromoted.

units.source_text: 然后高木名人同小野田六段对局，采用“朝鲜将棋”的下法。

en.t: Then Master Takagi played a game against Onoda, sixth dan, using the Korean shogi style of play.
The Master leaned against the armrest and watched the game.
